meta.description: Registry for provisional invariants or quasi-invariants for residue in Phase 3.

candidate_invariants.name: bounded_total_residue_measure
candidate_invariants.statement: Total residue measure remains bounded under declared finite or bounded recursive domains.

candidate_invariants.name: residue_equivalence_preservation
candidate_invariants.statement: Residue states remain equivalent when their admissibility-conditioning role is preserved under declared constraints.

candidate_invariants.name: saturation_ceiling
candidate_invariants.statement: Residue accumulation approaches or reaches a declared ceiling rather than unbounded growth.

candidate_invariants.name: source_sink_balance
candidate_invariants.statement: Residue gain and dissipation remain balanced over a declared recurrence cycle.
